Name: Emergency Exit
Effect: Whenever this Pokémon's HP reaches half or less, it will switch out to its pokeball, sending an allied Pokémon to take its place. If there is no allied Pokémon, the battle may end. This Ability's effect is not affected by Block.
Description: The Pokémon makes tactical escapes when the situation escalates out of control. You may force him to fight despite this but it won't like it.
